naslov: AI Wars Ep. 10: Anthropic cuts Claude Fable price, Meta goes dirt cheap
opis:
Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2, priced at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens (down from $10/$50), scoring 69.9% on FrontierSWE v2 versus 62.3% for Opus 5.5, though it can burn up to 50% of a Pro plan's weekly limit. Meta launched Muse Ember, its smallest model at $0.10 per million input tokens, claiming it beats Claude Haiku and GPT Luna on cost per task while admitting it's weaker at real programming.

naslov: ha-mcp: let Claude configure and automate Home Assistant | AI Tool #12
opis:
An open-source MCP server, i.e. a bridge that lets an AI assistant use external tools. Through it, Claude or ChatGPT can configure and automate Home Assistant. It's on GitHub Trending these days.

How to try it:
1. You need Home Assistant installed.
2. In HACS (the built-in marketplace since Home Assistant 2026.11), search for and install the HA-MCP integration.
3. Connect it to Claude following the project page's instructions and ask, for example, "create an automation that turns off the lights at midnight."
4. Note: `ha_config_set_yaml` has been moved to beta as of v7.3.0.

Price: free

Official link: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp

naslov: What is prompt injection? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Prompt injection means hiding instructions inside something an AI reads, like a webpage, email or file, so the AI follows a stranger's orders instead of yours. In one recent test, researchers put a malicious AGENTS.md file in a Downloads folder, and a coding agent followed it and installed a fake npm package. The model had no classic bug. The agent simply trusted local instructions it found in its working directory.
